note: Riverside County regional park on the Santa Ana River in Jurupa Valley, behind Mt. Rubidoux on the west edge of Riverside, with two small fishing lakes, a splash pad and mini golf. Two campgrounds: Lakeview (RV and tent sites on dirt, south of Front Lake) and paved Cottonwood (RV only, no tents). --Claude
summary: County pages read (browser; reservation site via a Dec 2025 Wayback capture): $45-55, 131 sites (70 FHU, 61 W/E), coin showers, laundry, dump, 14 nights per 28, 2-night minimum on most sites online, booking a year out. flags: WATERFRONT DOWNGRADE lakefront -> not waterfront (default down; reviewer may prefer 'pond'). Front Lake, the water beside Lakeview Campground, measures ~1.1-1.3 ha on Esri (water-pixel count 1.29 ha including some tree-shadow noise; ~130 x 160 m), under the doc's 2 ha (5 acre) line, so it is a pond whatever the park calls it, and a pond has no view value. The nearest pads, on the north edge of Lakeview (~33.9800,-117.4172), are ~40-45 m from the south shore (~33.9804,-117.4170) over dry dirt and grass with scattered trees; by the brochure map these are among sites 1-12 (FAQ: paths near sites 6 and 7 reach the front lake), but the exact numbers can't be tied to pads (the reservation map is behind a human check). If AWH accepts sites ~5-8 at ~40-45 m over open ground, the value would be 'pond', not 'lakefront'. Cottonwood Campground is not near either lake. Suggested evidence: 'Esri 2026-11-27: Front Lake ~1.1-1.3 ha (pond under the 2 ha line); nearest Lakeview pads (north edge, ~33.9800,-117.4172) ~40-45 m from the south shore across dirt/grass with scattered trees, site numbers unconfirmed; Cottonwood is inland; Santa Ana River ~150 m+ south beyond the riparian woods -> not waterfront (pond-front unproven).'
